about: Engine templates written for MAIN's command 'all letters A to Z' (2026-09-24/25), reviewed against docs/style sheet v1 (pavediens section 24) and contract v2.7 (2154106c033c). All stay isActive=false. Order n = the order Raivis reads the test letters in.

templates.subject: Tavs kabinets ir gatavs
templates.preheader: Tur jau ir preces no tava pirmā pasūtījuma.
templates.name: money:welcome_1 v1 — pēc pirmā pasūtījuma: preces kabinetā, viens ieteikums, piegādes rinda (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: First letter after a customer's first tiktik.lv order: their goods already sit in their kabinets, so the second order is one step; one affinity item (R1 only) and the free-shipping line; no discount, no deadline, normal price.

templates.subject: Kā tev ar ierastajām precēm?
templates.preheader: Tavas preces gaida kabinetā — pasūtīt var vienā solī.
templates.name: money:reorder_2 v1 — maigs atgādinājums, parastā cena, kabinets (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Second reorder rung: a gentle check-in at the normal price for a customer whose usual re-order moment has come and who did not order after reorder_1 (179).

templates.subject: Varbūt ir kādas vajadzības?
templates.preheader: Pietiek atbildēt ar vienu rindiņu — pārējo sagatavosim mēs.
templates.name: money:reorder_3 v1 — klusais jautājums, parastā cena, bez ieteikumu bloka (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Third and last reorder rung after 179 and reorder_2 got no order: the quietest letter, a C11-register check-in at the normal price (no discount, deadline or struck price); R block dropped, P grid, shortened cabinet box and D block kept.

templates.subject: Jauna preču partija — par tavu cenu
templates.preheader: Tieši tās preces, ko tu pie mums parasti ņem.
templates.name: money:winback_2 v1 — jauna preču partija, tava cena līdz datumam, kabinets (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Second win-back rung for customers silent for many months: a fresh batch of their usual goods has arrived and they get their own price for 7 days while it is in stock (price and date are A15 placeholder tokens until the contract carries them).

templates.subject: Tavu cenu turam vēl šoreiz
templates.preheader: Tava cena spēkā līdz ⟦LĪDZ DATUMAM⟧ — kamēr partija ir noliktavā.
templates.name: money:winback_3 v1 — partija vēl noliktavā, tava cena vēl spēkā (7 dienas), bez R bloka (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Third and last winback rung: calm, the batch is still in stock and the customer price still holds until the date; shorter than 180.

templates.subject: Atceramies, ko tu mēdzi ņemt
templates.preheader: Tām pašām precēm tev tagad ir sava cena.
templates.name: money:lost_quarterly v1 — ceturkšņa vēstule: jauna partija, tava cena 14 dienas, kabinets (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Quarterly wave to customers with no order for 12+ months: warm re-introduction, their restocked goods at a personal price for 14 days (price placeholders until the contract carries it), ordering via the cabinet.

templates.subject: Ko citi ņem pie tavām precēm
templates.preheader: Ja kaut kas noder, nākamreiz tas var atnākt tajā pašā kastē.
templates.name: money:active_xsell v1 — aktīvajiem: ko citi ņem pie tavām precēm, parastā cena (2026-09-24)
templates.purpose: Category widening for recent customers not yet due to re-order: the R1..R4 'bought together' items lead at their normal price, own goods follow as a quiet reminder; no discount, no deadline.

templates.subject: ⟦NEDĒĻAS TĒMA⟧ nedēļa: lētāk nekā parasti
templates.preheader: Cenas spēkā, kamēr prece ir noliktavā.
templates.name: money:akcija_weekly v2 — nedēļas akcijas rāmis; bez kabineta preču → nedēļas akciju lapa (2026-09-25)
templates.purpose: Weekly residual letter for everyone with no personal step this week (incl. empty kabinets): a fixed frame around the brand/theme Raivis picks, with the weekly product block inserted per campaign.

neutral_twins_about: MAIN 2026-09-25 (F4): 'Jauna partija' wording only when P1 carries fresh_batch; otherwise the neutral wording (review B). These are the NEUTRAL twins of 232/233/234: byte-identical to the fresh files except the fresh-batch sentences. NOT in Brevo and NOT read by template_put.py (it reads 'templates' only). The switch field arrives with contract v2.8; a campaign has ONE subject and preheader for all recipients (232 subject, 233 preheader differ).
